title: TÜV SÜD, Accenture and NVIDIA Unite to Fast‑Track AI Robot Safety Certification in Factories and Warehouses
summary: TÜV SÜD and Accenture have unveiled their new “Physical AI Safety Suite” at NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026, a framework designed to accelerate certification of autonomous robots and AI-driven systems in factories and warehouses. The suite uses digital twins, AI agents, and simulations to reduce certification timelines by up to 30%, helping manufacturers deploy automation faster and more safely.
